messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-4219 fired for `model-catalog-service` (high error rate)

pagerduty: Triggered on `model-catalog.service.prod` - priority P1 - escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre

sasha: acked. I'm on it, grabbing context and looking at the catalog write logs.

kevin: oncall here too, saw customer-reported 500s for chat generation starting ~10:02 UTC. Is this the same?

maria: support-bot reported several customers routing to model variant `gpt-lite-v2` failing tokenizer step: "Unknown token mapping". Could be a tokenizer mismatch with the catalog rev push at 09:58.

oliver: I see an automated catalog promotion build at 09:57 that changed default revision for `gpt-lite` family -> rev `r1345` (previous default r1339). Link: https://internal.redwood/catalog/changes/r1345

sasha: pulling the catalog diffs now. If autopromote pushed a rev that expects a new tokenizer config, that would explain the failure.

kevin: logs from model-router:```
2026-03-14T09:59:02Z ERROR route=chat service=model-router code=500 err="tokenizer initialize mismatch: expected vocab_size 50272 got 50256" request_id=abc123
2026-03-14T10:00:01Z WARN route=embeddings model=gpt-lite-v2 rev=r1345 fallback=none
```

maria: customers: 3 high-usage tenants are reporting degraded throughput and 5xxs for both chat and embeddings. Support P1s opened.

incident-bot: Escalation: alerting eng-sre on rotation -> @kevin @sasha @oliver (auto-escalate after 5m)

oliver: quick mitigation suggestion: pin routes for affected customers to previous revision r1339 and disable autopromote stream. We can roll forward once tokenizer compatibility is fixed.

sasha: agree. I'll apply a temporary route override to point traffic for tenant tags `org:enterprise-*` to rev r1339. Applying now.

sasha: /api-cmd router.override --selector "org:enterprise-*" --model "gpt-lite" --revision "r1339" --until 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z

incident-bot: router.override command accepted (job id job-7789).

kevin: while that's in flight, we should also disable the catalog autopromote pipeline to stop further bad defaults from being applied. Who has perms?

oliver: I can flip the autopromote gate. Doing a soft lock (prevents new promotions).

oliver: /infra-cmd catalog.autopromote lock --reason "emergency: tokenizer mismatch" --by oliver

incident-bot: catalog.autopromote locked by oliver (lock id lock-20260314-01).

maria: notifying impacted customers with a short blurb: "We've identified an issue with a model catalog promotion that caused tokenizer mismatch errors. We're routing your traffic to a compatible revision while we fix it; no customer data was exposed. ETA for full recovery: 60-90 minutes." Approving post now.

support-bot: Draft message queued for tenant owners + status page.

kevin: I pulled the r1345 artifacts to debug. There's a new tokenizer config file: `tokenizer.json` referencing `vocab_size: 50272` but model weights indicate 50256. Either the tokenizer bundle doesn't match the quantized weights or the promotion script used the wrong manifest.

kevin: suspecting a build step that regenerated the tokenizer after quantization but the artifact registry had stale index. Reproducing locally now.

sasha: job-7789 router override succeeded. Traffic for affected tenants is now pinned to r1339. Metrics: 5xx rate for those tenants dropped from 6.8% -> 0.4% over the last minute. :thumbsup:

maria: support: customers acknowledge mitigation, but want ETA on permanent fix. I'll relay 60-90m and note roll-forward plan.

kevin: found the mismatch root cause: catalog promotion script used template `tokenizer.v2.json` but the model bundle uploaded as `tokenizer.v1.json`. We need to regenerate tokenizer bundle for r1345 matching vocab_size 50256 OR repoint r1345 to the v1 tokenizer and update manifest.

oliver: do we prefer to rebuild r1345 or rollback its promotion? Since we already pinned customers, rollback promotion is safer until we have a validated artifact.

sasha: I can revert catalog default for the `gpt-lite` family to r1339 so new customers don't pick r1345. We already locked autopromote but setting default helps.

sasha: /catalog-cmd family.set-default --family gpt-lite --revision r1339 --reason "emergency rollback: tokenizer mismatch"

incident-bot: catalog default changed: gpt-lite -> r1339 (was r1345). Change id change-9911.

kevin: I'll start a rebuild pipeline for r1345 tokenizer with the correct manifest. Tagging @sasha for validation steps. Estimated rebuild + validation: 30-45m.

maria: support updated customers with change id and mitigation note. One customer asks whether this affects embeddings used in search. Answer: yes, embeddings requests routed to r1345 were failing; pinned route should restore search infra responses.

oliver: monitoring: setting a hold rule to prevent autopromote unlock until after manual QA.

oliver: /infra-cmd catalog.autopromote hold --hold-id hold-171999 --until 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z --by oliver

support-bot: Notifying support channel and updating status.redwood.ai: INCIDENT-4219: model catalog autopromote caused tokenizer mismatch; immediate mitigation applied (traffic pinned, autopromote locked). Next update in 30m.

kevin: quick note for postmortem: pipeline lacked an artifact-manifest checksum check and the promotion step didn't validate tokenizer vs model bundle. We'll add a pre-promote validation that loads a tokenization sanity check and tests a small sample request.

sasha: handoff: my oncall ends in 35m. If rebuild finishes before then, I'll validate and coordinate a controlled re-promote with manual QA. If not, I'll handoff to kevin.

kevin: standing by. If I take over, steps: 1) verify rebuilt tokenizer checksum, 2) run canary on 1% traffic for 15m with extra tracing, 3) unpin customers and update default.

incident-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: sasha (oncall) acknowledged at 1719991242; kevin acknowledged at 1719991280.

maria: recording customer impact summary for postmortem: "~3 tenants affected, elevated 5xxs for chat+embeddings between 09:59-10:05 UTC for tenants assigned to promoted rev r1345. Mitigation applied via router pin to r1339. No data exfiltration. SLA blips reported."

oliver: adding runbook entry: "if tokenizer mismatch after promo -> immediate lock autopromote, pin critical tenants to previous rev, revert default, start rebuild + validation."

kevin: rebuild job kicked off (job id rebuild-5572). I'll post progress and attach validation logs.

support-bot: Next scheduled update: 30 minutes or on next status change.

sasha: thanks team. Keeping this thread open for handoff or closure.

kevin: (later) rebuild completed, validation passed on local tests, starting canary deploy to 1% traffic for 15m.

incident-bot: Canary metrics: success rate 99.96% over 15m window for canary traffic. No tokenization errors detected.

kevin: ramping to 10% then 50% with monitoring. If stable, I'll unpin enterprise clients and set default to r1345 with new validated tokenizer.

sasha: before full promote, please add a pre-promote smoke check job that runs a tokenization sample and embedding compare.

kevin: added pre-promote job (job id smoke-7743) into promotion pipeline.

incident-bot: catalog default updated to r1345 (validated) at 1719991540 after manual QA; autopromote lock remains until manual unlock.

maria: support notified customers that traffic has been restored to validated rev r1345 and we will keep monitoring. Closing P1 followup tasks assigned.

oliver: filing postmortem ticket: PM-INC-4219 with action items (pre-promote validation, artifact manifest checksum, autopromote gating improvements).

sasha: closing handoff: I'm off rotation now, handing remaining follow-ups to kevin. Thanks everyone. :heart:
